name: Hashimoto Tasuku
source: Private university student. 19 years old. Grades are a little above average, face is fairly good-looking, and excels at sports. Handles everything smoothly and gets along well with people. Within the family, holds the position of mood-maker. Hobby is keeping a diary, recommended by mother.
